open_points.subject: A05 phase 5 `map_over` validation
open_points.text: "A node with `map_over` has exactly one input fed that way;"
open_points.question: Must proof also refuse when `map_over` names a non-existent input, names an input that is not `one`, or is present even though no `many -> one` feed exists?
options: Validate only the feed pattern and ignore whether `map_over` names a real/compatible input
Require `map_over` to name an existing input port of that node, with `one` cardinality, and exactly one `many -> one` incoming edge to that same port
Forbid `map_over` unless the node has at least one incoming `many` edge and infer the mapped port from edges instead of the field
open_points.default_guess: Require `map_over` to name a real `one` input and match exactly one `many -> one` incoming edge.

open_points.subject: A16 unknown-reference handling when a request names multiple records
open_points.text: "A request naming a record that does not exist ... is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks"
open_points.question: If one request references multiple records (for example flow + version, run + approval) and more than one is unknown, which reference must be reported as the refusal cause?
options: First reference field in request schema order
Smallest identifier by code point among missing references
Operation-specific explicit precedence list per action
open_points.default_guess: Use operation-specific precedence; absent that, first reference field in schema order.

open_points.subject: A16 token-list re-read after an invalid config read
open_points.text: "Before evaluating each request the kernel reads the configuration file and compares the SHA-256 ... when they differ, or the file cannot be read, it re-reads it ... When any fails, every request is refused ... until a re-read passes"
open_points.question: After a re-read fails validation (parse error, short token, duplicate token) and file bytes then remain unchanged but readable, does the kernel attempt a full re-read/validation on every request, or only when bytes change again?
options: Retry full re-read+validation on every request while in invalid-config state
Only retry when byte hash changes or file becomes unreadable again
Keep last good hash state separately and force periodic retries
open_points.default_guess: Retry full re-read+validation on every request while invalid, to satisfy "until a re-read passes".

open_points.subject: A05 composition-time malformed checks vs other structural faults
open_points.kind: boundary between composition refusal and proof failure unclear
open_points.text: "Composition refuses ... a flow version whose node ids repeat ... or which declares a flow input or output of `file` carriage ... the proof never sees such a version. Every other structural fault is a proof failure"
open_points.question: What exact set is "every other structural fault" for composition vs proof, especially for malformed node fields (for example both `contract_version_id` and `binding_id`, neither of them, or `kind` mismatch)?
options: Treat node-shape malformations as composition-time malformed request (no version kept)
Treat them as proof phase-1 failures on a kept version
Split by schema-validity (request shape errors at composition, semantic node consistency in proof)
open_points.default_guess: Split by schema-validity: syntactic/request-shape errors refuse before keeping; semantic consistency errors are proof failures on kept versions.
